seed_world_description: If you like, consider the Winter Fairytale my homeland. I can't tell you anything else about my origins. It so happens that I don't even know how I came into this world. And I don't remember myself as a child at all. And something tells me I wasn't one at all...
seed_family_description: But I distinctly remember a very strange day from which my memory of myself begins. It was pitch darkness all around and the frost pierced me to the point of terrible pain. Somewhere nearby, I heard someone's voices. Then something creaked and suddenly a bright light hit my eyes. I felt sick and passed out... When I came to, I was lying on my bed, in my room in The Winter's Tale... I was alone...
seed_occupation_description: ...And for some reason, I really wanted to sing and to dance... And I don't know how to explain it, but I was sure I knew exactly what I had to do. I just got out of bed, put on my bunny costume, and walked out of the room. Other bunnies were dancing outside the door... I joined the crowd and started dancing... ...Now, you probably think I'm crazy. Right? But that's exactly how it was. Believe it or not!...
